scope: Reviewed club facts only. Direct club replies take priority for descriptions; latest meeting notices supply day, time and room. The project owner confirmed weekly recurrence for all six clubs on 2026-11-02. No raw emails, inbox links, email addresses or access codes.

records.title: Student clubs — club info and joining (2026/27)
facts: Six student clubs covered by this 2026/27 guide are SAC, B-Well, BIPOC, Women's Society, BEAT and OMNI; other school clubs may also be available.
SAC: student activities, social events, volunteering and leadership. Weekly Tuesday cookie break (9:35 AM), C131 downstairs in Crooks.
B-Well: student wellbeing and peer support. Weekly Friday 6:30 PM in McNeill's.
BIPOC: multicultural activities, cultural sharing, volunteering and senior leadership. Weekly Thursday 6:15 PM, A255 in the Arts building.
Women's Society: open club activities and fundraising. Weekly Monday 1:20–1:50 PM, C131 downstairs in Crooks.
BEAT: environmental projects, initiatives and service hours. Weekly Tuesday 1:15 PM during lunch, C131 downstairs in Crooks.
OMNI: open social meetings, event planning and volunteering. Weekly Tuesday 6:00 PM, C131 downstairs in Crooks.
Regular schedules are subject to dated cancellations and school leave.

records.title: SAC club (2026/27)
facts: SAC organizes student activities and social events, with opportunities to plan events, volunteer and take leadership roles.
SAC meets every Tuesday during morning cookie break (9:35 AM) in C131, downstairs in Crooks Hall.
For 2026/27, Guy Wilkinson is the SAC captain. Ms. Tammie Ramsay is the staff contact working with SAC.
Interested students are invited to attend; meeting notices advertise volunteer hours and leadership opportunities.
Activity example: SAC organized the Fall Fun Fair on September 19, 2026, with a barbecue, games and prizes. Its 4:00 PM start was an event time, separate from the regular meeting.
Date-specific exception: the October 27, 2026 SAC meeting was cancelled. This does not cancel subsequent weekly meetings.

records.title: B-Well / BWell club (2026/27)
facts: B-Well supports student wellbeing and peer support, with activities that promote mental health, inclusion and community involvement.
B-Well meets every Friday at 6:30 PM in McNeill's.
The 2026/27 announcements identify Stella Burch and school counsellor Ms. Julia Folk as club contacts.

New students are encouraged to join as well as returning members. The first meeting recognized trained Peer Supporters with B-Well hearts for their doors and discussed volunteering for the Terry Fox Run.

Activity example: B-Well and BEAT announced a joint Cobble Hill hike for September 27, 2026 to promote inclusion, mental health and appreciation for the environment. The outing's noon departure was separate from the regular club meeting.

records.title: BIPOC club (2026/27)
facts: BIPOC celebrates Brentwood's multicultural community and helps students feel at home. It shares cultures through food, music, information, events, activities and outings.
BIPOC meets every Thursday at 6:15 PM in room A255 in the Arts building.
For 2026/27, the captain is Joanna Fakulujo and the teacher sponsor is Ms. Gage.
Meetings are relaxed social gatherings with snacks and opportunities to meet and talk with other students.
BIPOC offers volunteer opportunities for all students and leadership opportunities for senior students.

records.title: Women's Society club (2026/27)
facts: Women's Society is open to everyone and brings students together for club activities and fundraising.
Women's Society meets every Monday from 1:20 PM to 1:50 PM in C131, downstairs in Crooks Hall.
For 2026/27, the captains are Skye Stanton and Luella Jones; Ms. Sarah Langer is the staff contact.
Students can bring their lunch to meetings; the welcome notice explicitly says everyone is welcome.

Activity example: the October 22, 2026 cookie-decorating fundraiser in McNeill's supported breast cancer research and included pink ribbons for Breast Cancer Awareness Month. That dinner event was separate from the regular meeting.

records.title: BEAT club — Brentwood Environmental Action Team (2026/27)
facts: BEAT stands for Brentwood Environmental Action Team. Students can start, lead or help with environmental initiatives, projects and events, including opportunities to earn volunteer/service hours.
BEAT meets every Tuesday at 1:15 PM during lunch in C131, downstairs in Crooks Hall.
The 2026/27 club is led by Juliana Antunes Vilhena, with Ms. Amanda Mack as the staff contact.

Students can bring lunch, share ideas, brainstorm and get involved even without previous environmental experience. Join the club's Google Classroom through a meeting for initiative sign-ups and updates.
Activity examples include the joint September 27, 2026 Cobble Hill hike with B-Well and a November 2, 2026 survey with Leadership 12 about reducing food waste in Crooks Hall.

records.title: OMNI club (2026/27)
facts: OMNI welcomes anyone to join relaxed meetings with conversation, snacks and event planning. Meeting notices advertise volunteer opportunities.
OMNI meets every Tuesday at 6:00 PM in C131, in the basement of Crooks Hall to the right of the mailroom.
Joey Eckenstein sends the 2026/27 club announcements. Students interested in being a house representative can contact Joey or Ms. Emily Carroll.
Students may bring their dinner to meetings. Resources, forms and announcements are shared in the club's Google Classroom; ask at a meeting about joining.
Activity example: OMNI announced a free Board Game Café in McNeill's with board games and refreshments in October 2026. This was a separate social event, not the regular meeting.
